formulas.formula: Appointments, tips, clients and profit for hair stylists and salon owners.
Setup: your name, the year, card and app fees, a tax set-aside % and a monthly goal.
Service Menu: what you offer, the price, how long it takes and the product it uses.
Clients: your regulars and how often they should rebook.
Appointments: one row per visit. Blank price = menu price. Add tips and retail sales. Tick No-show if they didn't come.
Expenses, Monthly, Service Stats and Dashboard show what you really earn.
Service Stats shows what each service pays per hour after product. Price your menu with it.
Clients shows who is due back so you can send a reminder.
Taken from card and app payments only. Cash has no fee.
Tips count as income, so they are included in profit and taxes.
Green = good money or on track.
Red = no-show, due back or a typo.
Great hair, happy clients, healthy business.
